A [[Zygerrian]] [[Gender|male]] worked as an '''overseer''' at the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] of [[Kessel]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. The [[overseer]] transferred a shipment of [[spice]] to [[Rafa Martez|Rafa]] and [[Trace Martez]] in order for them to deliver it to the [[Pyke Syndicate]] on [[Oba Diah]].<ref name="Deal No Deal" />
